title: Mixed Event — Unnamed Harmony — Episode5 For Now, Let's Watch

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need has decided to try and go pro, and is practicing with more effort than ever. To make their own song to perform at shows, they decide to each come up with different parts to compare. Wanting to be of help to the band, Saki works harder than anyone else on her contribution, but...

rows.Line: The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Zzz...
C here, then E...

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Classmate
rows.Line: It's such a pain going back and forth between our classroom and the AV room. Can't we just do everything in one place...?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: You, no talking in the corridor! Other students are still in class!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Hm? Saki...?
Is she asleep at her desk...?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Saki never falls asleep during class. She's usually too focused on what the teacher's saying for that to happen...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then how about we use Saki's work as a basis next time to think about what kind of music we want to play as a band...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay. Let's sleep on it and see what we all come up with.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
And I'll keep doing my best to come up with something that really hits home!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Saki...)
After school

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, let's make the most of today! Let's go, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, sorry. The teacher asked me to handle some committee business. Would you mind going ahead without me...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, sure!
I'll see you later then!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, Shiho!
Since Ichi's gonna be busy with committee stuff for a while, let's go and...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Before that, Saki, can we talk?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Talk? About what?
Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: About coming up with an original song...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I came up with even more ideas for today!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm still not sure if any of it really suits us as a band, but I tried changing the way I write these.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But then it became harder to string notes and chords together, you know? Songwriting's so tough...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks for doing all this for us.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But again, you don't have to rush or anything.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, did Saki and Shiho decide to wait for me...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But something doesn't seem right... Did something happen...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I really appreciate how much effort you've been putting in lately.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: However, nobody's telling us to come up with an original song right this second either.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm certain that things won't go the way we expect at first...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And trying too hard at this stage might end up being more stressful than you can handle.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So let's try taking it more slowly, okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay...
Maybe I did get myself a little too worked up like you say.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I guess I convinced myself that we have to start getting our own songs out if we really do want to go pro...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see. In that case...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But there's a reason that I've been trying so hard lately...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I want to figure out what I'm capable of.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What you're capable of?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ever since Ichi started doing street performances, she's gotten way better at singing and playing her guitar, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona got over some of her fears by actually facing them, and now she seems a lot more confident in herself...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But what about me? That's what I asked myself...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're already doing plenty, Saki. You're the one who's always there to cheer us up and push us in the right direction...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That makes me happy, but I still want to contribute to our music somehow. I want to be able to do more for us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So please, let me keep doing this for a little while longer! I promise to be super careful about not overworking myself too!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami? What are you doing standing around here?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh! Ichika!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh? Hona! Ichi!
Are you done with committee stuff, Ichi?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, but I didn't realize you were still here. I finished doing what my teacher asked me to do, so we can head to practice now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Shiho? Is something wrong?
You seem concerned...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
No, it's nothing...
Let's go.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Nice work today, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, that was good!
I'll see you tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, please get home safe.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Bye.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami...?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank goodness. I wasn't sure I'd catch up to you. I was about to ask if you'd like to walk together, but you left so quickly...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Together?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. You have work after this, right? Would it be okay if I joined you until you get there?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Uh, sure...
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Our show's just around the corner. In your opinion, Shiho, how are we coming along?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Far from perfect, but good enough to perform in a show. You've all gotten much better too since we started practicing together more...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you. I'm glad...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We all really appreciate the way you've been looking after what each of us is doing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Really, it's nothing...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's not true. I mean, do you remember how just the other day you said my rimshots sounded a little weak?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I never would've noticed and been able to address it if you didn't tell me, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But all I did was speak my mind.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It just bothered me a little how you're always able to create a good rhythm but seem to hold yourself back sometimes...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm more confident now than I used to be, but I guess I still have quite a bit of work to do.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Even then, Shiho, you're the reason I've been able to commit more and improve so much...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So thank you for everything.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Again, really, it's nothing...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, I'm sure Ichika and Saki will tell you the same thing. You've helped us all so much.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I've been a little worried about Saki, lately. She's been working so hard...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She's...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She's doing that because of me...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Creating an original song, practicing for our show, and trying to go pro... It's all making her do this...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: My dream's forcing Saki to push herself too hard...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, that's not true either...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki isn't necessarily doing all this because she wants to become a professional musician.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: After that time you said that we wouldn't be able to stay together if we tried to go pro, we had a long discussion concerning that...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: About whether or not we'd be able to commit to that goal and to our music...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We each took a long look at ourselves, and we ultimately all decided to walk the same path as you, Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Saki too.
She decided that we're going to go pro together.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So for now, let's just watch over and place our faith in her, okay?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It might look like she's pushing herself a little too hard right now, but I'm sure she also understands exactly how you feel...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, I will. Thanks...
